name: Creamy Goat Cheese Linguine with Tomatoes, Spinach, Onion & Garlic

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve 1 cup of pasta cooking water before draining.)
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and small dice tomatoes; transfer to a medium bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Peel and small dice onions.
Preheat another large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the garlic and onion; cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion begins to soften, 4-5 minutes.
Add tomatoes, salt, and pepper to the pot with the garlic and onion; continue to cook, stirring often, until tomatoes begin to soften, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the tomatoes are cooking, wash, dry, and roughly chop the spinach (skip washing if the spinach came pre-washed).
Add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Crumble goat cheese into the pot; add cream and stir to combine. Reduce heat to low and continue to cook, stirring often, until the sauce is melted and combined, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (113 g) logs goat cheese
355 ml heavy whipping cream

instructions.primary_message: Add drained pasta to the pot and toss to combine; add reserved pasta water, a few tablespoons at a time, if necessary, to reach a saucy consistency.
To serve, divide pasta between bowls and enjoy!
